title: What Mattered, Ranked
kind: summary for the Hazel team: reports 045 to 051 gathered, the ingredients ranked, an order for a hand redo; work in progress
question: Of everything changed from 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-10 to make a livelit's slider in Hazel fast, what made the difference, how much did each change help, and in what order could the team redo it by hand in small increments? Matthew, 2026-11-10.
measurements: No new measurement of the app: each ingredient's before and after are the numbers reports 045 to 051 measured, cited by build. The figures come from each build's run of the Firefox check (scripts/jit_slides.py in jit.yml, hazelgrove/hazel, GitHub's machines, one run per build): the Witch slide's four slider steps (ms from the click to the picture changing; steps 2 to 4 plotted), a 3-second drag of the neck slider (frames a second), and the page's top-level marks from the picture to half a second after the worker's answer (ms). Builds 1 to 3's steps are report 050's, from report 046's runs. Code sizes: git show --numstat over the commits each ingredient names, in hazelgrove/hazel trial/694-view-jit.
builds: Numbered as in reports 050 and 051: build N is the build before it plus one change, all on trial/694-view-jit; the builds table in the page lists the ones cited, with commit and run. Build 38's figures use its second run, 42817304210.
